conviction_note: Q3 revenue and comparable operating result were pre-released, and the FY2026 guide was raised in a positive profit warning on 13 Oct. The release is therefore a reiteration day. What is new is the end-Q3 fuel hedge ratio for 2027 and the outlook wording, with Brent 4-10% above where it stood when the guide was set. That gives a slight negative lean (p_up 46) on a 4% unsigned move, which is the pre-released base raised for an oil-driven tape. The findings sum to -0.5 and the scaled number is -0.32. They agree in sign, and both are small because the main news is already out.

already_public.what: Positive profit warning (inside information): Q3 2026 revenue approx EUR 953m (834.9) and comparable operating result approx EUR 84m (50.7). FY2026 guide raised to revenue EUR 3.5-3.6bn and comparable operating result EUR 175-220m, from 3.4-3.5bn and 120-190m. 2027 guidance deferred to the FY2026 financial statements bulletin. The company said it will be difficult to increase 2027 fuel hedging from current levels.
September 2026 traffic (inside the pre-released Q3): passengers about +9.6% y/y, load factor 79.9%. Middle East routes suspended since 28 Feb.

new_in_release.expect: FY2026 EUR 175-220m reiterated, which implies Q4 of EUR 13-58m. A change two weeks after the raise is unlikely. Brent has risen since 13 Oct, but with Q4 about 70% hedged (end-Q2) the cost is a few EUR m, well inside a EUR 45m-wide range. Wording may lean cautious. No 2027 guide until February.

End-Q3 fuel hedge ratios for Q4 2026 and 2027, plus an updated fuel sensitivity. 2027 cover was about one third at end-Q2 and the company has said it is hard to raise. Expect the same or lower relative cover and a cautious 2027 tone. Mildly negative, mostly flagged.
unknown. Q3 is seasonally strong for operating cash flow, and net debt and liquidity are new figures. No source found to sign them.

findings.finding: The quarter and the raised FY2026 guide are already public. The 13 Oct positive profit warning pre-released Q3 revenue (~EUR 953m) and comparable operating result (~EUR 84m, 3m below Inderes' 87m) and raised FY guidance to EUR 175-220m. The stock rose 5.1% that day and has since fallen to below its pre-warning close (4.166 on 12 Oct, 4.144 at the seal).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the pre-release day (13 Oct 2026) the stock rose 5.14% on 453k shares, then gave all of it back over nine sessions. Earlier full results days with new numbers moved -8.8% (2024-10-29), +18.2% (2025-02-13), -17.3% (2025-04-29) and +16.2% (2026-02-11). On 2025-10-29, the last Q3 report, it moved -2.15%.
findings.original_quote: Sisäpiiritieto, positiivinen tulosvaroitus: Finnair nostaa vuoden 2026 ohjeistusta ja antaa ennakkotietoa vuoden 2026 kolmannen neljänneksen tuloksesta (Inside information, positive profit warning: Finnair raises its 2026 guidance and gives preliminary information on its Q3 2026 result). Finnish headline from the Nasdaq Nordic feed; the English parallel release is linked as the source.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced, which is the finding. The 5.1% jump on 13 Oct shows the market took it in. Only a revision of the pre-release would be unpriced, and preliminary figures this close to the report are rarely revised.
findings.independence: Inderes, 14 Oct: preliminary figures in line, minimal estimate changes. https://www.inderes.fi/en/research/finnair-strong-2026-progress-as-expected-headwinds-next-year

findings.finding: The release will update 2027 fuel hedge cover (about one third at end-Q2) after the company said on 13 Oct that raising it is difficult. Brent closed 105.69 on 13 Oct and since then has traded 105.9-116.7 (110.31 on 26 Oct). IATA put European jet fuel above $200/bbl in the week to 9 Oct. A cautious 2027 fuel paragraph is the one new forward line this release carries.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior: 2027 guidance is not due until February. After the 13 Oct warning, which carried the same 2027 hedging caveat, the stock gave back the whole +5.1%. Over 13-26 Oct it fell 5.4% against -2.5% for Air France-KLM, -1.0% for Lufthansa and IAG, and -0.8% for Norwegian. The caveat looks at least partly in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: The hedge ratio at end-Q3 and the size of the uncovered 2027 fuel bill are new numbers. Inderes' 2027 EBIT of 150m assumes falling fuel prices (Bloomberg curve), so a current-price sensitivity would sit below it. Against that, the qualitative warning is two weeks old and the stock already trades below its pre-warning level after underperforming peers by about 3-4 points. If the market had fully priced it, the release could not move the 2027 bar, and it plausibly still can.
findings.independence: Brent closes from Yahoo (BZ=F), 13 Oct 105.69 to 23 Oct 116.72 https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BZ=F?range=1mo&interval=1d. Inderes, 8 Oct: '2027 earnings expected to fall... fading hedge benefits' https://www.inderes.se/en/research/finnair-q3-looks-strong-but-next-year-will-be-tougher. These share the fuel fact with finding 3 but land on a different year.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (EUR 175-220m, implied Q4 13-58m) was set on 13 Oct with Brent near 105.7, and Brent is about 4% higher at the seal. With Q4 fuel about 70% hedged (end-Q2) and a disclosed sensitivity of EUR 18m per 10% over six months, the extra Q4 cost is a few EUR m, inside a EUR 45m-wide range. Likely reiterated, possibly with wording toward the lower half.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises: +5.1% on 13 Oct 2026. 22-23 Jul 2026 (Q2 with a raise): +1.3% then -10.4%. A reiteration two weeks after a raise has no precedent in the tape.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The fuel rise is public and the arithmetic says it lands inside the guided range, so it is sized near zero. Only a narrowing toward the low end would be news, and nothing sourced says that will happen.
findings.independence: Fuel sensitivity (EUR 18m per 10% over six months) as reported by Business Travel News Europe https://www.businesstravelnewseurope.com/Air-Travel/Finnair-warns-on-fuel-risk-as-it-trims-capacity-rise

outside_window.finding: First 2027 guidance, due with the FY2026 financial statements bulletin in February 2027. This is where the fuel-hedge exposure becomes a number.
